name: Fairmont Hamilton Princess & Beach Club
insider_take: This iconic pink palace has been Bermuda's crown jewel since 1885, where royalty has slept and Hollywood legends have played.
whats_special: The Fairmont Hamilton Princess is famous for its distinctive pink facade that's become synonymous with Bermuda itself. The hotel sits on Hamilton Harbour with its own private beach club, and features the world's largest hotel-based aquarium. Historic guests include Mark Twain, who wrote about the hotel, and it served as a secret Allied intelligence hub during WWII.
pro_tip: Book a harbour-view room on the higher floors for stunning sunset views over Hamilton Harbour, and don't miss the Crown & Anchor restaurant's famous fish sandwich – it's considered one of the best on the island.
dont_miss: The hotel's Japanese-inspired Willow Stream Spa, the Marcus' restaurant helmed by celebrity chef Marcus Samuelsson, and the complimentary ferry service to the private beach club. Take a stroll through Hamilton's Front Street shopping district, just steps away, for duty-free luxury goods and local crafts.
pros: Stunning harbor views from Hamilton's premier waterfront location
Private beach club with exclusive access and complimentary shuttle
Multiple award-winning dining venues and sophisticated bars
Full-service spa and comprehensive fitness facilities
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Bermuda properties
Beach club requires shuttle transportation from main hotel
